extras: Requires external installation of pfpdf and Node.js. Only works in the desktop app. Security warning: pfpdf renders HTML and scripts, so do not export untrusted notes.
problem: Obsidian notes lack a straightforward mechanism to be converted into professional, print-ready PDF documents.

relations.evidence: This plugin exports Obsidian notes to PDF. pfpdf lays out the pages

summary: A plugin that exports Obsidian notes to print-quality PDF documents using the external pfpdf tool, handling embedded and remote images.
